digest.component_or_area: metrics blame and bug close derivation
propositions: _blame_file_commits must distinguish between git failure (return None) and successful-but-empty blame (return []) to enable proper abort semantics
derive_caused_by performs a strict-majority culprit election over per-path blame results; partial path failures cause it to tally a subset and elect wrong caused_by links
derive_caused_by must abort (return None) when any per-path blame fails, rather than tallying incomplete data
Cloning with --filter=blob:none (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s) is the accepted degradation over full clone (1.04 GiB / 59 s); --filter=tree:0 must never be used (3.57 GiB, 3.4x larger)
Documentation must record measured clone numbers and explain the blobless promisor degradation accepted by the design
